meaning_paraphrase: Knowing through cognitive forces within the soul itself, not through the senses.
plain: knowing from within, through insight the soul reaches by itself rather than through the senses

meaning_paraphrase: Linking thoughts, concepts and ideas into an ordered whole.
plain: linking thoughts into a well-ordered whole

meaning_paraphrase: Will is the decisive factor in experience and in the make-up of the world.
plain: putting the will first, as what shapes experience and the world

meaning_paraphrase: Taking things as they show themselves in experience.
plain: learning from experience, taking things as they show themselves

meaning_paraphrase: Seeking the world-picture through inner experience.
plain: looking inward, seeking the meaning of the world through inner experience

meaning_paraphrase: The essence of things lies beyond experience, yet can be pointed to.
plain: sensing that the heart of things lies beyond experience, yet can be pointed to

meaning_paraphrase: Hidden forces stand behind things and can be sought out.
plain: searching for the hidden forces behind things

meaning_paraphrase: Seeking the divine in what is external.
source: GA 151, lecture 3 (22 Jan 1914): the three soul "tones"; Anthropomorphism as the special single case

meaning_paraphrase: A world-picture formed from intuitive flashes out of one's own depths.
source: GA 151, lecture 3 (22 Jan 1914): the three soul "tones"; Anthropomorphism as the special single case

meaning_paraphrase: Taking nature as it presents itself.
source: GA 151, lecture 3 (22 Jan 1914): the three soul "tones"; Anthropomorphism as the special single case

meaning_paraphrase: Restricting oneself to what one experiences in and around oneself.
source: GA 151, lecture 3 (22 Jan 1914): the three soul "tones"; Anthropomorphism as the special single case
